title: daf-jev: A Composable Python Decision Toolkit for the TypeSafe Jev (System One) API
description:
daf-jev is a modular, composable Python client and decision toolkit for the TypeSafe Jev (System One) API, which turns generated text into typed machine decisions.

One HTTP endpoint (POST https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone) exposes three question primitives — noul (a 0–1 probability), choice (an option drawn from a probability distribution), and score (a rating on ordered rubric levels). On top of the typed answers the package provides pure-logic composition patterns (composite_score, confidence_gate, route, pick), a concurrent batch Evaluator, confidence-calibration statistics, a CLI (ask / evaluate / models / docs-verify / serve), a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposing seven tools plus a jev://docs/snapshot resource over stdio, an agent skill, six runnable examples, a live-API benchmark suite (batching speedups, pipeline latency, confidence calibration), a matplotlib figure registry, and a reproducible {{TOKEN}}-parameterized manuscript pipeline.

Released as open-source software under the MIT license at https://github.com/docxology/daf-jev.
